title: Decentralized Archive Land
tagline: Decentralized Archive Land is the one-stop destination for buying, selling and exploring NFT fashion items and offer style which you can share and show off your NFT outfit
description: Decentralized Archive Land is a market dedicated to NFT fashion. It would be like Web3 Grailed. The issues of the Web2 fashion marketplace, such as the 10%+ selling fee and authenticity checks, will be unnecessary here. Style also offer an online community where you can connect with other NFT holders.
how_its_made: This is my first hackathon as a developer. I usually work as an artist, but I participated here with the desire to hack as a developer. Therefore, I participated this time as a solo. I utilized ENS, IPFS sponsor technology for this project. I used ENS to register my account and manage my information. I also used IPFS to store my NFTs.
